name: W Sao Paulo
positioning: A Vila Olimpia high-rise with rooms from the 25th floor up, a 40th-floor rooftop pool, a spa inspired by Brazil's biomes and design drawn from Brazilian motifs
best_for: Travelers who want high-floor city views and a rooftop pool
Visitors doing business around Avenida Faria Lima who also want nightlife nearby
Spa-goers who want treatments rooted in Brazilian nature

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Vila Olimpia.
The design blends stone, wood, curves and color into a streamlined tropical-chic look drawn from Brazilian motifs.
Rooms feature locally inspired artwork and contemporary furniture that nod to Brazilian modernism.
Guests can enjoy the Sunset Ritual at the WET Deck and Stretching Bossa Nova at FIT.
The US3 beauty salon inside AWAY Spa offers hair, makeup and wellness services.
AWAY Spa services include couples massages, body scrubs, facials and a steam room.
Yoso Bar e Cafe offers Japanese-inspired mixology and a daytime cafe.
The Penthouse I has a lounge with a tropical-contemporary vibe, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a bathtub.
Fully furnished W Sao Paulo Residences are available for short and extended stays.
The JK Iguatemi luxury mall is steps away.
The hotel has easy access to Avenida Faria Lima, Sao Paulo's financial and business corridor.
The hotel's music scene features live DJ sets, intimate sound sessions and performances by Brazilian and international artists.

highlights.text: The WET Deck rooftop pool is on the 40th floor, with views over the city.
Rooms start on the 25th floor, with views of Sao Paulo.
AWAY Spa is perched high above the city and offers treatments inspired by Brazil's biomes.
The Signature Suites are on the highest floors, each with panoramic city views.
L40 Cozinha de Latitude is the 40th-floor rooftop bar and restaurant, with a panoramic city view and a globally inspired menu.

considerations.text: The bars and restaurants have a smart casual dress code; swimwear and flip-flops are not permitted.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
